note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large banks (no central bank ranking was read): the state's Rafidain and Rasheed banks and the Trade Bank of Iraq, which weren't tried this time for want of the research's budget; the National Bank of Iraq, already read, is written in full. The National Bank of Iraq's list of fees and commissions (2026, version 10), its credit card commission prices, read in full on 2026-10-30 (first read 2026-10-29 for the Silver Visa alone): its three credit cards, priced in US dollars, are written with their primary card issuance fee (Infinite 100, Platinum 70, Silver 50 dollars; the list states no yearly fee), monthly interest of 2%, a flat cash withdrawal fee of 5%, a late payment fee of 5% of the due amount with a minimum of 25 dollars (the due amount read as the minimum due), and a flat 10 dollars a month for exceeding the limit. The Silver Visa's issue fee, left out on 2026-10-29, is now written. The international transactions margin of 4.5% sits with the debit card prices and isn't written on the credit cards. The list states no minimum payment or grace period. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): no bank was added. Tried: the Trade Bank of Iraq (Cloudflare, answering 522), Rafidain Bank and Mansour Bank (Cloudflare checks), Bank of Baghdad (its site lists only debit cards), and Cihan Bank and Kurdistan International Bank (no answer); a search for any Iraqi bank's card commission list found none.
